title: NPL Auction Season 3 Live Updates: 155 Players Shortlisted, Aasif Sheikh Leads Category A
excerpt: The Siddhartha Bank Nepal Premier League Season 3 auction is live in Kathmandu, with 155 shortlisted players and Aasif Sheikh headlining Category A.
body: The Siddhartha Bank Nepal Premier League Season 3 auction is live in Kathmandu, giving all eight franchises their biggest squad-building day before the 2026 tournament window.

A total of 347 Nepali cricketers registered for the auction pool, and 155 made the shortlist after screening. The final auction list is split into three price bands: 5 players in Category A, 27 in Category B and 123 in Category C.

Category A carries a base price of NPR 10 lakh and features Arjun Gharti, Bibek Kumar Yadav, Aasif Sheikh, Rupesh Kumar Singh and Trit Raj Das. Aasif is the headline name after Janakpur Bolts released him during the retention window.

Category B has a base price of NPR 5 lakh, while Category C starts at NPR 2 lakh. Foreign players are not part of this domestic auction list because franchises can sign overseas players through direct negotiations.
Janakpur Bolts enter the auction with the biggest remaining purse at NPR 66.25 lakh. Kathmandu Gorkhas have the tightest room at NPR 34 lakh, which makes every bid more important for their balance.

The retention cycle already shaped the auction board. Kathmandu kept captain Karan KC and five others, Lumbini retained Rohit Paudel after their title run, Sudurpaschim kept Dipendra Singh Airee, and Janakpur moved into a rebuild after releasing Aasif Sheikh.

By the end of the auction, each franchise should move closer to a 16-player squad around its retained core. For NPL fans, the most important storylines are the Category A bidding war, Janakpur's large purse, Kathmandu's limited budget and where Aasif Sheikh lands next.

title: NPL Season 3 Mega Auction will be held on July 6, 2026
excerpt: The Nepal Premier League Season 3 mega auction gives all eight NPL franchises another key squad-building checkpoint before the 2026 tournament.
body: The Nepal Premier League Season 3 mega auction is scheduled for July 6, 2026, with all eight franchises expected to use the event to complete important squad roles.
For NPL 2026 followers, the auction is the clearest checkpoint before preseason planning, overseas-player confirmations and final team combinations begin to settle.
Janakpur Bolts, Sudurpaschim Royals, Chitwan Rhinos, Karnali Yaks, Kathmandu Gurkhas, Pokhara Avengers, Biratnagar Kings and Lumbini Lions all have different squad needs entering the auction window.
The biggest areas to watch are powerplay batting, death bowling, wicketkeeping depth and all-rounder balance because those roles usually decide short T20 tournaments in Nepal conditions.
